title: MANTIS neural network predicts survival and treatment effects in childhood brain tumors
summary: MANTIS, a neural network on genome-wide DNA methylation data from 2,786 patients, predicts individualized 10-year survival in medulloblastoma and ependymoma with concordance indices up to 0.80 +/- 0.07, above current clinical indicators. Its treatment-effect estimates identify about 60% of average-risk medulloblastoma patients with no significant survival disadvantage (P = 0.683) on less intensive craniospinal irradiation. The medulloblastoma model was validated in three independent trial cohorts (898 patients); treatment effects derive from retrospective trial data, not randomization by the model.
ai_technology: MANTIS artificial neural network on DNA methylation and copy-number data
organization: Broad Institute; Boston Children's Hospital; Dana-Farber Cancer Institute

evidence.tested: Development on 2,786 patients with validation of the medulloblastoma model in three independent trial cohorts (SJMB03, ACNS0331, ACNS0332).
evidence.unknown: Prospective testing of therapy personalization; ependymoma validation was not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts individualized survival and treatment effects
